description: Intra-Community supply of goods to an EU customer (zero-rated, E1 box)
notes: Under VATCA 2010 s.21, supplies of goods to a person in another EU member state are charged at zero rate and reported in the E1 box (intra-community supply of goods). The customer accounts for VAT in their own country under the reverse charge.

transaction.description: Sale of widgets to French customer, shipped to FR
